site_name: LAND BOUNDED BY OXESTALLS ROAD, EVELYN STREET, DRAGOON ROAD AND GROVE STREET  LONDON, SE8
description: Mixed-use redevelopment for five buildings comprising residential dwellings (Class C3 Use), purpose-built student accommodation (Sui Generis) and a range of commercial, business and service uses (Use Class E), together with cycle parking, public realm works and provision of open space at Land bounded by Oxestalls Road, Evelyn Street, Dragoon Road and Grove Street SE8 - Plot 5 only.
